snapshot.title: FSDO Notification — Drone Over Fairgrounds

transcript.speaker: DCO
transcript.text: This is the Incident Commander, Harwick UAS Operations Group. I'm calling to report a persistent, unregistered UAS over the Harwick Fairgrounds during a NO FLY day. The aircraft is broadcasting Remote ID 'RID-BM-12-004' and has been detected in three separate passes since 11:00. It is not registered in the FAA UAS Facility Map and is operating in a public event area under a formal flight restriction.

transcript.speaker: FSDO-HWK
transcript.text: Understood. We have received your report under the SAFER SKIES Act. We are now initiating federal coordination. Please preserve all telemetry, Remote ID feeds, and vendor logs in the incident folder on HUOG-NAS01. We will confirm the operator’s location and status within 24 hours.

transcript.speaker: DCO
transcript.text: Confirmed. All data is preserved in \HUOG-NAS01\ops\incident-log\2026-10-25-\ as per HUOG-ERP Section 11.3.

snapshot.instructorNote: This call confirms the FSDO’s formal involvement under the SAFER SKIES Act. The ASO must verify that the incident folder on HUOG-NAS01 includes the Remote ID feed, vendor photo, and operator location estimate. Watch for any attempt to access or alter logs.
